versions.changelog: 注册链接增加渠道来源参数 src=clawhub，用于统计平台注册转化

- Expanded data coverage to more than 21 million businesses across 10+ provinces, including phone numbers.
- Clarified usage policies: free access (10 queries/day/IP), with further use requiring registration for an API Key via the official site.
- Improved search functionality with category auto-correction and friendly hints for unsupported counties.
- Updated instructions for handling API Key errors and query limits, including required official customer service contact details.
- Revised sample commands and documentation for clarity and accuracy.
